title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Brushing Teeth
summary: Today, Baby Leo and friends learn how to keep their teeth clean and healthy! With Marjona's help, they discover the fun of brushing their teeth and why it's important. Together, they create a happy tooth-brushing routine!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of brushing their teeth.
beats: The friends gather in Baby Leo's room. They talk about their fun picnic and how nice it was to share snacks. Marjona remembers how important it is to take care of their teeth after eating.
Baby Leo asks, 'Why do we need to brush our teeth?' Marjona explains how brushing helps keep their teeth shiny and healthy. Bella shares a clever idea to make tooth brushing fun!
The friends decide to make their own tooth-brushing song. Bobo giggles and adds funny dance moves. They practice singing and dancing together, feeling happy and excited!
Bella hops around to find colorful toothbrushes for everyone. They choose their favorite colors and get ready. Twinkle sprinkles some sparkle magic to make it even more fun.

The friends line up at the mirror, toothbrushes in hand. Marjona shows them how to put toothpaste on their brushes. Baby Leo asks, 'What flavor is mine?' Everyone laughs at the silly flavors they imagine.
They start brushing their teeth together, singing their fun tooth-brushing song. Bobo bounces and giggles while brushing, and Bella hops around to cheer them on.
After brushing, they rinse their mouths and look at their shiny teeth in the mirror. Marjona claps her hands and says, 'Great job, everyone! Your smiles are so bright!'
They all hug and remind each other to brush twice a day. Baby Leo exclaims, 'Let’s make it a fun routine!' They talk about how they can sing their song every morning and night.
As they leave the bathroom, Twinkle glows brightly. She says, 'Happy teeth, happy friends!' Everyone laughs and agrees that taking care of their teeth is fun!
The episode ends with a shiny view of their happy smiles. They dance around cheerfully, singing their tooth-brushing song together.
